subject: Handoff: Implementation checklist, milestone owners, and delivery timeline
messages:
From: Jennie Park <jennie@acadiahealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding — next steps and kickoff

Jonas / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The execs here at Acadia want to move forward, contingent on a clear implementation plan and defined roles. I attached our signed SOW (SOW_Acadia_v1.pdf) to this message.

Could you share a mutual action plan (high level milestones, owners, dates) and a short checklist we can hand to our engineering and procurement teams? Critical items for us: SOC 2 evidence deliverable, procurement info for PO, and a pre-prod validation window.

Preferred kickoff: week of Sep 6 — we have availability on Sep 7 (10–12 PT) or Sep 8 (2–4 PT).

Attaching: SOW_Acadia_v1.pdf (attached)

Thanks,
Jennie
Jennie Park
Sr. Program Manager, Integrations
Acadia Health

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Jennie Park <jennie@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — next steps and kickoff

Jennie —

Appreciate the quick turn. Draft MAP attached (MAP_Acadia_v1.xlsx) — summary below. We can finalize on the kickoff; I penciled Sep 7 at 10:30 PT.

High-level milestones (owner — target):
- Contract & PO received (Procurement) — marissa_cole — target: 2026-09-10
- Compliance intake / SOC 2 evidence exchange — stephanie_nguyen — target: 2026-09-15
- Environment provisioning (dev/staging/prod) — marcus_lin — target: 2026-09-17
- Integration & test harness (API keys, routes, auth) — jonas_weber (technical lead) — target: 2026-09-24
- Pre-prod validation window (2 weeks) — customer + redwood QA — start: 2026-09-27, end: 2026-10-11
- Go-live / cutover — joint decision — target: 2026-10-18

Acceptance criteria for pre-prod:
- Latency SLO verification for typical 512-token prompt (p95 < 250ms)
- End-to-end request/response traceability in Console
- Sample dataset inference run (10k records) with zero data leakage flags

Risks / dependencies:
- PO delay will push provisioning start dates
- SOC 2 evidence request: please confirm which SOC artifacts (Type II / controls matrix) you can share vs. which require an NDA

Next steps:
1) Confirm kickoff: Sep 7 10:30 PT or propose alternate.
2) Add procurement contact (cc) so marissa can start PO cadence.
3) Share any required compliance intake forms today if possible.

Attaching: MAP_Acadia_v1.xlsx

—
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

From: Jennie Park <jennie@acadiahealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, Luis Gomez <luis.g@acadiahealth.com>, ProcureOps <procureops@acadiahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — next steps and kickoff

On Mon, Aug 31, 2026 at 11:02 AM Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Draft MAP attached (MAP_Acadia_v1.xlsx) — summary below.

Thanks Jonas — attached SOW confirmed. Sep 7 10:30 PT works for our engineering leads. Looping Luis (procurement) and ProcureOps so we can get PO details in motion.

Compliance note: Acadia will share SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. Where should we upload that? We also have a short vendor questionnaire (3 pages) that we’d like Redwood to complete before provisioning. Can Stephanie own that?

Procurement contact: Luis Gomez (luis.g@acadiahealth.com) — he will need a formal invoice/PO terms and a billing contact.

Jennie

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jennie Park <jennie@acadiahealth.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — next steps and kickoff

Thanks for looping Luis — welcome.

Luis / ProcureOps — action items from Redwood procurement side:
- I'll prepare the invoice and standard payment terms (Net 45) by 2026-09-03. Please confirm billing contact and PO reference number once available.
- I will flag any non-standard T&Cs that require legal engagement; expect a turnaround of 1–2 business days for simple redlines.

On compliance & questionnaire: Stephanie — can you take the vendor questionnaire and schedule a short 30-minute call with Acadia's compliance lead if needed?

Operational notes (added to MAP):
- Provisioning windows: dev/stage on 2026-09-17; prod access for validation starts 2026-09-27. Marcus will spin up infra and share DNS/IP allowlist details.
- Escalation path: first-level (CS) marissa_cole@redwood.com; second-level (SRE) marcus_lin@redwood.com; exec escalation jonas_weber@redwood.com.

Acceptance detail: we'll run two smoke cycles during the pre-prod window: a functional pass (day 2) and a performance pass (end of week 1). If either fails, we will agree on remediation timeline during the daily stand.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, ProcureOps <procureops@acadiahealth.com>

All — great progress. Confirming kickoff on Sep 7 10:30 PT (calendar invite sent).

Updated short checklist (for kickoff packet):
- PO / invoice details (owner: marissa_cole) — due: 2026-09-10
- Vendor questionnaire completed & SOC 2 upload (owner: stephanie_nguyen) — due: 2026-09-15
- Dev/stage provisioning (owner: marcus_lin) — ready: 2026-09-17
- Integration smoke tests & sample run (owner: jonas_weber) — complete: 2026-09-24
- Pre-prod validation window 2026-09-27 → 2026-10-11 (joint verification)
- Go/no-go decision meeting on 2026-10-12; target go-live 2026-10-18

Logistics: I've uploaded the MAP and kickoff slide deck to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3C-Acadia-Onboarding (see "Kickoff packet" folder). Please review the acceptance checklist before the meeting.

If procurement needs an updated billing contact or custom invoicing fields, Marissa will follow up directly with Luis.

Thanks — see you all on Sep 7.
